what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from the Dominican Republic in all host countries combined: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 20783 asylum seekers from the Dominican Republic.
The United States hosts the largest share, 73.8%, followed by Uruguay, Mexico and Brazil.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for the Dominican Republic, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2023 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 50 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals of asylum seekers summed over every host country; refugees from the Dominican Republic are counted separately.
